card.title: Xbox Series X No Video Repair

source.title: Xbox Series X No Video Repair

claims.statement: Xbox Series X no video: try low-resolution mode and another HDMI cable, then check the port, EMI filters below it, the HDMI encoder/retimer, the ESD protection/booster IC (U21, underside; can be bypassed for diagnosis) and the 2151 5 V switch (replaceable with a similar part from an original Xbox One Ethernet circuit).
Replacement ESD booster options include the original BGA IC or third-party solder-in boards/flexes.

procedure: Enter low-resolution mode; try another cable.
Check retimer and U21 ESD booster (bypass to test).
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
